title: 102 Dalmatians: Puppies to the Rescue/Minigames
text:
Minigolf
9 holes of Putt-Putt.

Dig-Dog
A matching game.

Tiltmaze
A game where you have to avoid knocking the ball in the holes.

Checkers
Simply the game of checkers.

Ice Race
A race against Cruella's toys.

Jam Dance
A game where you can make music.
